title: Fix unwrapped COSE_Sign1 protected header in tunnel-auth envelope
description: Security review finding (spec/06-security.md:733): the §8.11 tunnel-auth COSE_Sign1 protected header is the unwrapped map h'a1013a00010000'. RFC 9052 defines the COSE_Sign1 protected field as bstr .cbor header_map, and the other four envelopes in the same file (lines 323, 605, 898, 1028) use the wrapped form h'47A1013A00010000' citing 08-gateway-coordination.md §6.5. Protected bytes are covered by the Sig_structure, so a §8.11-conformant signer produces signatures strict COSE verifiers reject; accepting both forms creates envelope ambiguity in a security object. Change §8.11 to the wrapped form.
close_reason: spec/06-security.md:733 changed to bstr-wrapped h'47A1013A00010000' + 'bstr-wrapped' comment, matching sibling envelopes (323/605/898/1028), RFC 9052 bstr .cbor header_map, pinned vectors (tunnel_authorization.json sig_structure embeds 47a1013a00010000), and all three implementations (Rust PROTECTED+bstr, C tests, Python decoder requires bytes). Verified no unwrapped h'a1013a00010000' remains in spec/ or docs/. 3x delegated codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-pass 1 finding filed as new bead (P3, missing wrapper-form continuation comment). Pre-existing red: all 12 Python tunnel_auth tests fail on clean HEAD (unrelated to this markdown-only change) -- filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-ktfz (P1).
